settings.signup_enable_help: Lets guests create an account with a passkey from the sign-up modal. The forum's own sign-up setting must also be enabled.
settings.rp_id_help: Leave empty to use the current domain. This must be the registrable domain suffix of the origin (for example example.com).
settings.rp_name_help: The name shown by the browser while a passkey is created.
settings.origin_help: Full origin including scheme (for example https://example.com). Leave empty to use the current request origin.

log_in.passkey_error: Passkey sign-in failed. Please try again.

sign_up.passkey_help: The password field is optional. If you leave it empty, you can set a password later with "Forgot password".
sign_up.missing_fields: Enter a username and email address first.
sign_up.password_too_short: The password must be at least 8 characters, or leave it empty.
sign_up.session_expired: The sign-up request expired. Please try again.
sign_up.credential_exists: This passkey is already registered. Please try again.
sign_up.registration_failed: The account could not be created. The username or email may already be in use.
sign_up.error: Passkey sign-up failed. Please try again.

settings.no_passkeys: You have not registered any passkeys yet.
settings.device_name_prompt: Give this passkey a name (for example "Work laptop").
settings.delete_confirm: Remove this passkey? You will no longer be able to use it to sign in.
settings.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
